author: Shikhar Jolly
description: Exploring AI, product thinking, technology, and the ideas shaping how we work and live.
aboutBody: I'm Shikhar — a product management enthusiast and consultant who enjoys turning complex problems into clear, useful experiences. At Deloitte, I work at the intersection of business and technology: translating customer journeys into product features, user stories, and requirements, then partnering with product owners and engineering teams through testing and go-live. I also explore how GenAI can make product discovery and delivery smarter. Before consulting, I worked on integrations and automation at Maersk, delivering 40+ end-to-end B2B integration solutions and helping reduce manual data entry by 80%. Idea Atlas is where I think out loud about AI, product management, technology, and the ideas worth unpacking — with curiosity, practical examples, and as little jargon as possible.
aboutSignature: Curious about the problem. Focused on the product. Always learning.
